name: Twin Hill's Tale
source:
You play as a scriptwriter who is tired of living his current life and he decides to move away and chase his dream to become an accomplished bestseller writer. Teaching in the local university, our protagonist is starting his new life and you can help him.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/fokkenproductions]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一名厌倦了目前生活的编剧，他决定离开并追逐他的梦想，成为一名出色的畅销书作家。我们的主角在当地大学任教，正在开始他的新生活，你可以帮助他。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/fokkenproductions]Patreon[/url]]
